info.title: Market Intelligence API
info.description: Pay-per-call market intelligence for AI agents, built on observed data. On-chain order flow from executed DEX trades on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Robinhood Chain and Solana (buy/sell pressure, momentum, anomalies vs each asset's own baseline, large trades, smart-money wallets, candles and daily datasets); token risk checks and swap quotes; Hyperliquid perps funding, open interest and crowding; SEC EDGAR (XBRL fundamentals, Form 4, Form 144, 13D/13G, dividends, fails-to-deliver, 8-K) and European ESEF fundamentals; European short interest (AMF); ECB, Eurostat, US Treasury and Federal Reserve data; CFTC positioning, EIA oil inventories and the official macro calendar; GDELT and SEC news; and deterministic analytics primitives on numbers you supply. Every answer is timestamped and names its source. Decisions (/api/v1/decision*) are a rule-based aggregation of these data with a free, live track record (/api/v1/decision/track-record). The chain query parameter of the token routes names the chain the token lives on; it is never the payment network, which every paid route lists in x-payment-info.networks as CAIP-2 ids.
info.x-guidance: Every paid route answers HTTP 402 with x402 payment requirements (USDC on Base, Polygon, Arbitrum, World Chain or Solana; EURC on Base or World Chain); pay and repeat the request. You are charged only on HTTP 2xx: an unknown symbol is a free 404. Start with GET /api/v1/intelligence/{symbol} (live on-chain order flow of one asset), GET /api/v1/intelligence/summary (what is moving), GET /api/v1/intelligence/token-risk/{address} (before buying a token) or GET /api/v1/report/{symbol} (filings, flow and news of one stock). Free: /coverage (which symbols and sources exist), /api/v1/datasets, /status (data freshness), /api/v1/decision/track-record (measured hit rates). A signal of INSUFFICIENT_DATA means too few trades in the window. Full guide: /llms.txt.

get.summary: Search trading opportunities matching a goal
get.description: Goal-driven opportunity scan for agents. Name an objective and constraints; get ranked symbols with supporting and conflicting evidence grouped by independent source (spot_dex_flow, perp_positioning, smart_money), typed risk factors, data quality, the live 1h hit rate of the signal and the next calls to make. Deterministic, no model in the loop. Objectives: unusual_buying, unusual_selling, breakout, breakdown, crowded_positioning (direction against the crowd), smart_money_accumulation, smart_money_distribution. An empty result list is a valid answer when data is fresh (filteredOut says why); 404 (not charged) only without fresh data; 400 (not charged) lists accepted values.

post.summary: Buy or top up prepaid credits
post.description: One x402 payment of the pack price ($5, $20 or $50; credit $5, $22 or $60) returns an API key with that credit (shown once). With an existing credit key in X-API-Key the pack is added to it. Each call made with the key costs the route's x402 price; calls answered with HTTP 400 or above are refunded. Main-network payments only (no testnet).

post.summary: Subscribe a webhook to market alerts (prepaid pack)
post.description: Push instead of polling. One x402 payment buys a pack of 7 days and up to 200 deliveries to your public HTTPS URL; the pack starts when the payment settles. Events: decision_change (the hourly decision of a symbol with live on-chain trading, about 40, changed action), unusual_flow (non-normal 5m trade-flow event with confidence >= 60, at most hourly per symbol), funding_extreme (a Hyperliquid perp with over $5M open interest reaches >= 50%/yr or <= -25%/yr funding), news (classified news or filing with materiality >= minMateriality, default 4 of 5; filter by categories and symbols) token_risk_change (the verdict or sell simulation of up to 5 watched tokens changed; checked every 30 minutes) and stablecoin_depeg (a dollar stablecoin reaches WATCH at 30 bps or DEPEG at 100 bps; checked every 5 minutes). Each delivery is a JSON POST {id, subscriptionId, event, symbol, occurredAt, data, deliveriesLeft, expiresAt} with headers X-MI-Event, X-MI-Delivery, X-MI-Timestamp and X-MI-Signature = sha256=hex(HMAC_SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body)). A 2xx within 10 s counts as delivered; failures are retried after 30 s and 5 min and do not use up the pack. After 50 failures in a row the subscription is suspended until POST /{id}/resume; missed events can be fetched from GET /{id}/events. Private, loopback and non-HTTPS URLs are refused and redirects are not followed.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL that receives the POSTs

get.summary: Catch up on missed webhook events (free with the secret)
get.description: Events of the subscription since a time (default 24 hours, at most 14 days), oldest first, with their full payloads and delivery status: lets a subscriber whose endpoint was down catch up without polling the paid routes. Events that were not delivered count against the pack when first fetched here, so the pack is the same whether events are pushed or pulled; those beyond what is left are withheld. Up to 100 per call; follow next.

get.summary: Get the gift links contract, chain and fee
get.description: Free. Gift links send USDC by link or QR code: the sender locks the amount in a contract with no owner or admin (create at /gift), the link carries a one-time key, and whoever holds it claims the whole gift to their own wallet. Gifts are 0.01 to 10 000 USDC; the sender pays a 1% fee on top, kept only when the gift is claimed: a cancelled or expired gift goes back to the sender with the fee. Addresses on the OFAC SDN list are refused. This server never holds the money or the key. USDC on Base.

200.description: Contract address, chain id, token, fee percent and explorer

400.description: Invalid parameter: the message says which and what is allowed. Never charged.

post.summary: Use when the MCP client should load few tools
post.description: Use when the MCP client should load few tools. Compact MCP server with the 18 most used tools: live decision, pre-trade check, opportunity scan, snapshot, move explanation, token verdict and risk, new tokens, swap quote, Fed rate odds, prediction markets, DeFi yields, market summary, macro calendar, news and fundamentals. Each tools/call costs its HTTP route price; the full server is /mcp.

402.description: Payment required: the x402 requirements (price, networks, payTo) are in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header and the body. Sign one of accepts[] and repeat the request with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Nothing is charged until a 2xx answer.
